_about: Defaults Simitall uses when study_spec.json does not give a value. Every default used is written to sim_truth.json under assumptions, so the user sees it. Variances are given as ratios of the residual SD so the default scale follows the outcome.

intercept.note: baseline mean of the primary outcome when the spec gives none

residual_sd.note: used when power.residual_sd is missing (10% of the default intercept)

effect_in_residual_sd.note: when power.minimum_detectable_difference is missing, the largest treatment difference = this many residual SDs

level_effect_pattern.note: k levels get effects evenly spread from 0 (first level, sorted) to the full effect; with 2 levels the difference equals the effect

interaction_effect.note: replaced by interaction_effect_ratio; kept for older code

block_sd_ratio.note: SD of fixed block/rep effects, as a ratio of residual SD

random_sd_ratio.note: SD of each random term in the model, as a ratio of residual SD

subsample_sd_ratio.note: within-unit SD of subsamples (leaves of one plant), as a ratio of residual SD

attrition.note: fraction of units lost; from power.attrition when given

interaction_effect_ratio.note: interaction between treatment factors (e.g. genotype x water, treatment x time): the effect of the first factor between its first and last level differs by this ratio x the main effect between the first and last level of the second factor (linear-by-linear pattern; first levels get 0). Spec power.interaction_effect or the interaction_effect argument gives the size directly; 0 means no interaction
